challengePolicy: Compile immediately from each validated frozen proposal and pinned source packet; preserve actual dependency/request hashes before native dispatch. No proposal-level permission or automatic retry.
representationPolicy: Exact duplicate factor declarations reuse prior; changed declarations get new candidate IDs with full trace; cross-unit descriptions retain typed contextual references; no scientific repair or implication.
maxChallengeContextPolicy: Measure actual compiled prompt including normalized prior and typed comparison context; stop above220k conservative combined estimate, never truncate sources.
launchGate: Root starts at4 after varied compact validation, may ramp after valid actual proposal/challenge pairs; no native call made by preparation.
